explication: PCL is a standalone library for 2D/3D image and point-cloud processing. A typical user supplies point-cloud or sensor data, processes it through representation, search and analysis algorithms, then consumes results in applications or visualization. The tree also shows distinct algorithm domains and GPU, stereo, and sensor capabilities. Most algorithm relationships are inferred from product structure rather than inspected call sites, so those links are dashed; the OpenNI device-manager relationship is visible in the sampled source.
